cells.gaps: The universal service fund ARE described in February 2025 as levied at 3% of operators' turnover and paying for coverage projects had its decree repealed in July 2026, with its resources moved to the Treasury, and nothing found replaces it.
cells.note: Stage 3 because the digital ministry's 2026 budget rose 104.6% on 2025. Not stage 4, because the fund that was the act has been repealed since and no other act has been found.
